description: This file implements the RemoteDispatcher interface for remote service invocation in the Apache OFBiz framework, providing methods for synchronous and asynchronous service execution, scheduling, and service export control.

classes.name: RemoteDispatcherImpl
classes.description: Implementation of RemoteDispatcher for remote service invocation, extending UnicastRemoteObject and managing service execution and scheduling.

methods.name: RemoteDispatcherImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the remote dispatcher with socket factories and dispatcher instance.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with the given context.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with a transaction timeout and transaction requirement.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously, ignoring errors.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with transaction parameters, ignoring errors.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a requester, persistence, and transaction options.

methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a requester and persistence.

methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a requester.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with persistence.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with just the context.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and waits for the result, with persistence.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and waits for the result.
